g.text: Fraction of three phases pointing within 2.2°

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: Tone-frequency sweep: do the maps point in the right direction?
81 frequencies / two on-grid directions / three phases / quiet and independent microphone noise
Analytical plane wave, source RMS −26 dBFS; noise RMS −36 dBFS where present. All candidates receive the same source wave at their native microphone positions.
This measures strongest-pixel pointing with a source always present, not detection probability. Different N gives different observation time.
Narrowband spatial aliases and coarse frequency steering can cause errors even with contiguous bins; no microphone/PDM response or acoustic SPL calibration.
